blocks.source: ＳＦＣ版と比較して、それほど大きく変更があるわけではないが、戦闘中のセリフなどの文章が増えている。追加された部分については若干、セリフ回しに気になる部分があったけれど、ケチを付けるほどではないし、元々の完成度の高さは保証されている。ちなみに、ＳＦＣ版では手薄だったＬルートが最も強化されているらしい。（※筆者はＣルートしかプレイしてません。）
blocks.translation: Although it has not been changed on a particularly large scale compared to the SFC version, more text has been added, including dialogue during battles. I had a few minor issues with the dialogue in the added sections, but they were not serious enough to criticize, and the original's high level of quality remains assured. Apparently, the L route, which was relatively underdeveloped in the SFC version, has received the most enhancements. (※The writer only played the C route.)

blocks.source: システム／バランス
blocks.translation: System / Balance

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ版から、ほとんど別物といってよい規模で変更がされている。変更するのは構わないけど、気になった点がワラワラ。
blocks.translation: The game has been changed on a scale large enough that it can almost be called a completely different game from the SFC version. I have no issue with making changes, but there are a whole lot of things that bothered me.

blocks.source: クラス別レベルとレベルアップボーナス
blocks.translation: Class-Specific Levels and Level-Up Bonuses

blocks.source: なぜか、キャラ毎ではなくクラス毎（職業）にレベルを共有するようになった。問題はクラスのレベルアップ時に戦闘に参加していたキャラは能力にボーナスが入ること。そのため、序盤に仲間になったキャラは能力が高くなりやすいが、後半に仲間になったキャラは相対的に能力が低く使いにくい。
blocks.translation: For some reason, levels are now shared by class (job) rather than by character. The problem is that characters who participated in battle when a class levels up receive ability bonuses. As a result, characters who join early tend to have high abilities, while characters who join later have relatively low abilities and are difficult to use.

blocks.source: 同一クラスのレベルアップ
blocks.translation: Leveling Up the Same Class

blocks.source: 色んなクラスのキャラを使用するより、なぜか、同じクラスをたくさん使ったほうが経験値を多くもらえてレベルアップしやすい。パーティ編成を色々考えるよりも、全員がニンジャなどの極端なプレイの方が有利なので、プレイしていて萎えてしまった。
blocks.translation: For some reason, using many characters of the same class gives more experience and makes leveling up easier than using characters from various classes. Rather than carefully considering party composition, an extreme play style in which everyone is a ninja or something is more advantageous, which made me lose interest while playing.

blocks.source: 新規クラスの初期レベルが１
blocks.translation: New Classes Start at Level 1

blocks.source: 新しく手に入ったクラスのレベルは常に１からとなる。しかも、非常にレベルが上がりにくい調整となっているため、後半のクラスをまともに使えるようにするまでにはかなりの時間が必要となる。新キャラ＝新クラスの場合、スキルが揃っていないため、なお大変。
blocks.translation: Newly acquired classes always start at level 1. Moreover, the game is balanced so that leveling up is extremely difficult, so it takes a considerable amount of time before you can use later-game classes properly. When a new character also means a new class, it is even more difficult because they do not yet have a full set of skills.

blocks.source: ＤＱ６に例えると、レベルは職業で共有。全員を戦士にすると経験値が４倍に。しかも、レベルアップ時に力ボーナスが入るのでムキムキになる。
blocks.translation: To use Dragon Quest VI as an example, levels are shared by job. If everyone becomes a warrior, you get four times the experience. On top of that, you receive a Strength bonus when leveling up, so everyone becomes muscle-bound.

blocks.source: しかし、後半バトルマスターとして加入したテリーはレべル１で貧弱。戦士に転職すれば、レベルは他の仲間と同じになるが、力はチャモロにも及ばない。
blocks.translation: However, Terry, who joins as a late-game Battle Master, is frail at level 1. If he changes to a warrior, his level becomes the same as the other party members', but his Strength does not even match Chamoro's.

blocks.source: ……というような謎な状況。
blocks.translation: ...That is the kind of baffling situation this creates.

blocks.source: レベル制限
blocks.translation: Level Restrictions

blocks.source: 装備・魔法・スキルなどを装備するにはクラスのレベルが条件となる。新しい装備が手に入っても、誰も装備できないなんてことはざら。装備の制限は入手できるタイミングや店の価格で調整すれば、十分だろうに、なしてこんな仕様に？
blocks.translation: A class level is required to equip equipment, magic, skills, and so on. It is quite common to obtain new equipment only to find that nobody can equip it. Equipment restrictions could have been adequately adjusted through availability timing and shop prices, so why use a specification like this?

blocks.source: ＤＱ３に例えると、王者の剣を手に入れたけどレベル４０まで装備できないみたいな。
blocks.translation: To use Dragon Quest III as an example, it is like obtaining the Sword of Kings but being unable to equip it until level 40.

blocks.source: 敵が無駄に硬い
blocks.translation: Enemies Are Unnecessarily Tough

blocks.source: ナイトやドラゴン、ゴーレムなどが異様に硬くて、倒すのが面倒。レベル差があったりして、攻撃力が高くない場合は、ダメージが１しか与えられないことも珍しくない。かなりレベルを上げていたのにラスボスに攻撃しても、まともにダメージを与えられる手段がほとんどなかったのには困った。
blocks.translation: Knights, dragons, golems, and the like are absurdly tough, making them tedious to defeat. When there is a level difference or your attack power is not high, it is not unusual to deal only 1 damage. Even though I had leveled up considerably, I was troubled by the fact that there were almost no ways to deal meaningful damage when attacking the final boss.

blocks.source: また、ナイトには次のターンまでの間、ダメージを1/10に減らすスキルがあるけれど、これを敵側に使われた場合、非常にイライラさせられる。
blocks.translation: Knights also have a skill that reduces damage to one-tenth until the next turn, and when the enemy uses it, it is extremely frustrating.

blocks.source: スキルシステム
blocks.translation: Skill System

blocks.source: 有利不利なスキルがハッキリし過ぎていて、誰がやっても似たような構成になりやすいし、効果が大きすぎて、スキルを習得したタイミングでバランスが激変する。例えば、攻撃力ＵＰというスキルは、身につけないとロクにダメージが通らない。遠隔攻撃命中率ＵＰのスキルを付ければ、正面からでも弓が余裕で命中するので、戦略も何もあったもんじゃない。
blocks.translation: The distinction between advantageous and disadvantageous skills is too clear, making similar builds likely no matter who plays, and their effects are so significant that the balance changes drastically as soon as you learn certain skills. For example, without the Attack Up skill, attacks barely deal any damage. If you equip the Ranged Attack Accuracy Up skill, arrows hit easily even from the front, leaving little room for strategy.

blocks.source: 何より、スキルの数が多すぎて、メニュー画面で装着するのが手間になる。
blocks.translation: More than anything, there are simply too many skills, making equipping them on the menu screen tedious.

blocks.source: アイテム共有
blocks.translation: Shared Items

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ版ではアイテムを使用するには、戦闘前に事前にキャラに持たせる必要があった。今回は、アイテムをパーティ全体で共有するため、個別に持たせる必要はなくなった。しかし、アイテムで回復が容易にできてしまうため、クレリックの存在意義が薄れてしまった。加えて、回復魔法を使うにしても効果は固定で、能力に依存しないため、クレリックを使う意義がさらに低くなる。
blocks.translation: In the SFC version, to use an item, you had to give it to a character in advance before battle. This time, items are shared by the entire party, so there is no longer any need to assign them individually. However, since items make healing so easy, the cleric's purpose has been diminished. In addition, healing magic has a fixed effect that does not depend on abilities, further reducing the point of using a cleric.

blocks.source: ＡＩの出来が悪い
blocks.translation: Poor AI

blocks.source: 例えば、敵が戦闘開始時にちまちま補助魔法を掛けあったりするのだけど、効果が小さい魔法が多くテンポが悪い。敵もアイテムを使用するのだけど、少しでもＨＰが減っていた場合に回復アイテムでちまちま回復してくる。ボス敵ですらこちらに攻撃せずに、しょぼい回復や補助をおこなって、ターンを無駄使いしてくるのはさすがに頂けない。
blocks.translation: For example, enemies slowly cast support magic on one another at the start of battle, but many of these spells have weak effects, which hurts the pacing. Enemies also use items, and if their HP is even slightly reduced, they slowly heal themselves with recovery items. It is simply unacceptable for even boss enemies to waste turns performing pathetic healing and support actions instead of attacking us.

blocks.source: ＤＱ３に例えると、バラモスが薬草で回復してくるみたいな。
blocks.translation: To use Dragon Quest III as an example, it is like Baramos healing himself with medicinal herbs.

blocks.source: 合成
blocks.translation: Synthesis

blocks.source: 店で合成をおこなうことで、強力なアイテムを作成できるが確率で失敗する。失敗しても、どうせロードしてやり直すだけなので作業的になってしまう。
blocks.translation: You can create powerful items by synthesizing them at shops, but the process can fail. Even when it fails, you will just reload and try again anyway, making it feel like tedious busywork.

blocks.source: 全体的にプレイヤーの手足を縛るような要素が多く、不自由かつ手間がかかる。ユーザインタフェースは悪くないのに、何かとひっかかる。
blocks.translation: Overall, there are many elements that tie the player's hands and feet, making the game restrictive and cumbersome. The user interface is not bad, yet something or other keeps getting in the way.

blocks.source: そもそも、どういうプレイスタイルをとれば楽しめるのかが非常につかみ辛い。まさか、全員ニンジャみたいな、極端なプレイをして欲しかったわけではないと思うのだけど……。
blocks.translation: To begin with, it is extremely difficult to figure out what kind of play style is actually enjoyable. I do not think they really wanted players to adopt an extreme style with everyone being ninjas, though...

blocks.source: 戦闘中に５０手までの動作をやりなおせるCHARIOTや、クリア後にストーリー中の要所に戻ることができるWORLDについては、プレイをやり直す面倒を省けるので評価できる。
blocks.translation: CHARIOT, which lets you redo up to 50 moves during battle, and WORLD, which lets you return to key points in the story after clearing the game, deserve praise because they spare you the trouble of replaying sections.

blocks.source: CHARIOTに付いては、度が過ぎた初心者救済システムという気もするが、スパロボシリーズ等ＳＲＰＧにありがちな、リセットとロードの繰り返しをさせられるよりは、よほどテンポが良くていさぎよい。
blocks.translation: CHARIOT may be an excessively generous system for helping beginners, but compared with being forced to repeatedly reset and reload, as is common in SRPGs such as the Super Robot Wars series, it offers much better pacing and is refreshingly straightforward.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: ユーザインタフェースが改善され、戦闘中の行動順序が常に表示されるようになった。（ＦＦ１０等の後発作品からの逆輸入といったところか。）ボタンを押した際の反応速度や、敵の思考時間なども、ＳＦＣ版と比較すれば、大きく改善されていることがわかると思う。
blocks.translation: The user interface has been improved, and the action order during battle is now always displayed. (It seems to have imported features from later games such as Final Fantasy X.) The response speed when pressing buttons and the enemies' thinking time have also been greatly improved compared to the SFC version.

blocks.source: つくづく、システム・バランス両面に問題がなければだけど……。
blocks.translation: If only there were no problems with either the system or the balance...

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: 不細工になったザエボス。人間離れしたザパン、ガンプなど。一部、顔グラに違和感を感じるが、ドット絵などは大体ＳＦＣと同じ。魔法エフェクトなどは大きく変更されているが、それなりにテンポも良好で綺麗。
blocks.translation: Zaebos has become ugly, while Zapan, Gamp, and others look less than human. Some of the face graphics feel slightly off, but the pixel art is mostly the same as in the SFC version. The magic effects and such have been significantly changed, but they are attractive and maintain reasonably good pacing.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ版にあった音楽の原型を崩さずに、うまくアレンジがされている。伝説のオウガバトルから音楽が使用されているのも嬉しいところ。ただ、音楽の使用箇所にはあれ？と思う場所もいくつかあった。
blocks.translation: The arrangements are well done without compromising the original essence of the music from the SNES version. It is also a nice touch that some music is taken from Ogre Battle: The March of the Black Queen. However, there were also several places where I found myself wondering, “Huh?” about the choice of music.
